A '''Location''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type that makes up the battlefield. Locations are [[System]]s (space) or [[Site]]s (ground, interiors, docking bays, and similar). Each side of a location may generate Force, shown as [[Light Force]] and [[Dark Force]] icons.

Force drains happen at locations you control. Related sites and systems are grouped by planet or vehicle name (for example [[Tatooine]] and [[Tatooine: Cantina]]).
